title: 奇趣风格3D乙烯基玩具
prompt: Chibi-style 3D vinyl toy of [subject], rendered in [color1] and [color2] tones, front-facing on a white background. Minimalist composition with soft shadows, oversized head and tiny body proportions, clean OC renderer output in Cinema 4D. Toy-like shine and playful charm.
description: 使用 Nano Banana Pro 模型，轻松打造奇趣风格的 3D 乙烯基玩具，以极简设计和双色调色彩呈现可爱大头小身造型，适合玩具创作、角色周边和生动营销视觉，带来玩具般光泽与趣味魅力。
